messages.text: Morning all. KYC docs for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0244}} keep failing on DocVault upload. The pipeline shows the doc step stuck in retry for about 40 min now. Anyone else seeing this?
Looking now. DocVault itself looks healthy from our side. Do you have the error text from the KYCPipeline task log?
It says 'upload timeout, attempt 5 of 5' and then requeues. Doc is the entity formation PDF, around 18 MB, plus the signed beneficial ownership form.
FWIW wire room had an onboarding hold on a_00500 this morning for the same client, probably waiting on this KYC refresh. Is that why? {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00500}}
Yep, likely the same refresh. Low risk client, but the periodic review lapses if we can't attach the docs. Not urgent for wires, Greg, nothing to release yet.

Found something. The pipeline retries with no backoff, so 5 attempts fire within seconds and all hit DocVault's per-token throttle. AuthSSO token refresh is also racing with it. Large files make it worse.
That explains why smaller docs go through fine. Can we just resubmit manually in the meantime?
Yes. Wait a couple of minutes between attempts and upload one doc at a time. I'm also bumping the per-token limit for the service account temporarily.
Tried the formation PDF alone, it went through on the first try. Uploading the BO form now.
Both docs are in DocVault and attached to the case. Pipeline moved on to SanctionsScreen. Thanks Sam.
Quick question for whoever knows: do the retried uploads create duplicate docs in DocVault? Seeing two entries on a case we handle for a_00501 loan paperwork. {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00501}}
Possible, yes. A timed out upload can still land server-side, then the retry writes a second copy. We don't dedupe on checksum today. I'll check the case.
Confirmed, two identical copies from this morning's retries. I'll mark the extras as superseded rather than delete them, since DocVault retention rules apply to client records.
Good call. Please leave a note on the case so audit sees why there are duplicates. I'll cross-check {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0244}} file once you're done.
Plan for the fix: exponential backoff with jitter on KYCPipeline doc uploads, checksum-based dedupe, and chunked upload for files over 10 MB. I'll open a ticket and tag the pipeline owner for review.
Sounds good. Can we also get an alert when a doc sits in retry more than 15 minutes? Today we only noticed because I was watching the queue.
Yes, adding that to the ticket. I'll alert into this channel so you don't have to watch it manually.
Thanks both. I'll hold off chasing this one from the wire room side since the docs are attached now.
